credits.title: Angelman
credits.overview: Every day, Arnaud comes across the mysterious Mr. Angel on the stairs of his building. As he helps him take his groceries upstairs, Arnaud finds out that he is actually Angelman, the first of the superheroes, now a forgotten old man.

credits.title: One Week-end
credits.overview: For 10 year-old Hector, the coming weekend is certain to be a very special one. He's about to meet his father, someone he hardly knows, and spend two days and two nights with him.
